Beijing's vague commitments protect Iranian economic interests while nominal stability demands open trade routes.

The Breakdown & Plane Error:
The report confuses diplomatic theater (WHO is talking) with structural coercion (WHAT leverage Beijing actually holds over Tehran).

Social Physics Analysis:
China runs a Smart Selfish Maneuver, projecting neutral mediation while securing energy flows. Iran maintains a destructive loop of proxy extortion, creating manufactured crises.

The Trajectory: The Path of Deception.
When you map diplomatic pretexts against ongoing proxy attacks, it plots a direct trajectory toward Greater Destruction. Destructive feedback loops overwhelm stability.

The Unavoidable Truth: Iran's proxy attacks on shipping and energy infrastructure threaten global stability.

The Unavoidable Lie: Beijing acts as an impartial mediator enforcing international maritime law.

Diplomatic appeals cannot mask the structural alignment between Beijing's energy needs and Tehran's aggressive posture.

China's telling Iran to chill out on the oil shipping lanes, but Tehran's proxies keep launching missiles anyway. Classic double game.
